english: 12-15. It was due to his majestic power that the rocks remained floating in the middle of watery expanse; Laṅkā was besieged by the monkeys and the Rākṣasas were killed easily. Khara, Dūṣaṇa, the great demon Triśiras and fourteen thousand other demons were killed in battle instantly. And this letter of authority was issued by him. How can it not be everlasting?
